caption: The drawing depicts a large, oval-shaped ceramic jug with a narrow top and a wider, rounded lower body. The jug is tan or light brown in color, with two curved handles attached symmetrically at the neck, extending from the top on both sides. The front of the jug features blue decorative designs, including a pair of stylized birds facing each other, perched on, or near, leafy branches. The leaves and feathers are rendered with fine line work. Above the birds, there is some cursive text, also in blue, which appears to read, “Uriah Doolittle & Perry.” There is a square mark containing a circular indentation or symbol located near the bottom center of the jug. The background of the drawing is plain and light, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Jug (for Wine, Cider, or Vinegar)
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
